text: 据中国有色金属工业协会硅业分会消息，本周工业硅市场呈现“期货震荡反弹、现货止跌企稳”的分化走势。受行业政策预期及供应端收缩消息提振，期货价格一度上冲至8450元/吨附近，周内整体反弹超3%；但现货市场跟涨乏力，本周报价持稳，连续数周的下跌态势暂告一段落。供应端收缩信号持续强化，市场底部特征逐步显现。
text_en: According to the Silicon Branch of the China Nonferrous Metals Industry Association, this week's industrial silicon market showed a divergent trend of 'futures rebounding with volatility, spot prices stabilizing'. Boosted by industry policy expectations and supply-side contraction news, futures prices briefly surged to around RMB 8,450/ton, rebounding over 3% for the week; however, spot market gains were limited, with quotes holding steady this week, ending several consecutive weeks of declines. Supply-side contraction signals continue to strengthen, and bottom characteristics are gradually emerging in the market.
